Name: DuraVent 3PVP-36B 3" Inner Diameter - PelletVent Pro Type L Chimney Pipe - Double Wall - 36" Pipe Length

Features fully unitized, twist-lock construction in 3" and 4" diameters. Listed at 1" clearance to combustibles in the USA and Canada. It can be used in both vertical and horizontal installations.
